output.reason: The changelog line on its own is vague [ev-6a3cc5f0de76], but the linked PR spells out the change. By default the distributor now adds a `service_name` label to any stream that doesn't already have one, taking its value from existing labels listed in the per-tenant `discover_service_name` config [ev-ac0989d2345f][ev-11df3101cc0f][ev-89504cdf0d22]. The default list is `service`, `app`, `application`, `container`, `container_name`, `app_kubernetes_io_name`, `component`, `workload` and `job`; if none of these labels is present the value is `unknown_service`, and setting the list to empty turns detection off [ev-11df3101cc0f]. That covers who is exposed (any tenant ingesting streams without a `service_name` label while the default config applies) and what happens if the operator does nothing (those streams get a new `service_name` label automatically), so the applicability and consequence aspects can be written.
